newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BIS plans news conference at 1400 gmt.
newsitem.headline: BIS plans news conference at 1400 gmt.

text.p: The Bank for International Settlements, which is expected to announce soon an expansion to include emerging economic powers in Asia and Latin America, said it will hold a news conference at 1400 GMT today.
The news conference will be held by Wim Duisenberg, president of the Dutch central bank and chairman of the BIS.
It follows the regular monthly meeting of the central bankers from the Group of 10 (G10) industrialised and a meeting of the BIS board.

The identities of the central banks that could join the BIS is a closely-guarded secret and a recent Reuter survey of 15 potential members -- including Russia, India, Malaysia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Brazil, Chile and Venezuela -- revealed that only the Bank of Korea was in actual talks about membership. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
